en.title: Creating a New Tournament
en.excerpt: Complete walkthrough of the tournament creation wizard, form fields, venue specifications, and registration rules.
en.content:
Tournament Creation Overview

The tournament wizard guides organizers through configuring an archery event. Creating an event establishes a dedicated management workspace containing category rosters, target maps, scorekeeper portals, and bracket trees.

General Information & Rules

Navigate to Tournaments > click + Create Tournament and configure the following parameters:

  • Tournament Name: The official name of the championship (e.g., Jakarta Open Archery Championship 2026).
  • Event Description: Detailed technical handbook, dress code guidelines, sanctioned bow specifications, and contact hotline.
  • Sanctioning Body: Specify if the event follows World Archery rules, national federation standards, or local club regulations.

Venue Coordinates & Range Setup

Provide exact venue information so athletes and coaches can navigate easily on competition day:

  • Venue Name: Stadium, sports hall, or archery field name.
  • Complete Address: Street address, city, and postal code.
  • Range Type: Outdoor open field, indoor facility, or covered shooting line.

Registration & Competition Timeline

Set four critical milestone dates:

  1. Registration Open Date: When public online signups go live.
  2. Registration Close Date: Deadline for participant entry and payment.
  3. Event Start Date: Official practice day or first qualification session.
  4. Event End Date: Medal matches, podium ceremony, and certificate issuance.

Promotional Banner Assets

Upload a high-quality landscape image (16:9 aspect ratio, 1920x1080 pixels recommended). This banner appears prominently on the Archeris homepage event carousel and public registration headers.

Draft Mode vs Instant Publishing

New tournaments save as Draft by default. You can configure categories, test target allocations, and review registration fees in private before publishing to the public.
